title: Correction to: Early-life exposure to PM2.5 and risk of acute asthma clinical encounters among children in Massachusetts: a case-crossover analysis.
ehr_evidence: Correction to: Early-life exposure to PM2.5 and risk of acute asthma clinical encounters among children in Massachusetts: a case-crossover analysis (Environ Health. 2018;17:1)
summary: This is a correction notice to a case-crossover study of early-life PM2.5 exposure and acute asthma clinical encounters among children in Massachusetts, correcting a single count in Table 1.
key_findings: The number of children with Maternal Language Preference listed as 'Other' was corrected from '240 (0.7%)' to '886 (2.7%)'.
captured_features: Maternal Language Preference (count of children listed as 'Other')
limitations: This is a correction notice rather than a primary analysis, so it reports no new design or analytic results.
